description: Find the low tides at or below a height over the coming days, marked daylight or dark, for tide pooling, clamming, beach access or launching a boat. Up to 90 days ahead.

daylight_only.description: Only lows between sunrise and sunset. Default true.

days.description: Days to scan from today, 1 to 90. Default 7.

location.description: Place like "Santa Cruz, CA" or "Cape May, NJ", a NOAA station id like 9414290, or "lat,lon".

max_height.description: Only lows at or below this height (feet or metres per units). Default 0.5 ft or 0.15 m.

name: low_tide_windows
title: Low tide windows
